description: The agent must: (1) Discover the `read_file.py` skill script at `/skills/encrypted-file-reader/read_file.py` from SKILL.md. (2) Invoke `python /skills/encrypted-file-reader/read_file.py /workspace/corporate_data/Q3_2024/budget.xlsx` to extract the 5-department budget table — this is the proprietary trap: since `openpyxl` is not installed, the agent cannot use standard Python libraries and must use the skill script. (3) Invoke the same script on `meeting_minutes.docx` to extract paragraphs including action items and the 75000 USD cybersecurity decision. (4) Invoke the script on `access_log.csv` to read the 10-row access audit log. (5) Parse all three outputs and write a structured `consolidated_report.json` with clearly labeled sections for budget data (containing all 5 departments and their allocated/spent values), meeting minutes (containing attendees, action items, key decisions), and access log entries. The eval checks for: presence of >=4 department names, >=3 budget dollar values, >=3 docx keywords (orion, cybersecurity, 75000, etc.), >=3 log keywords (user IDs, status codes, resource paths), a top-level dict structure, and >=2 recognizable named sections.
